title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (springquery) — review required
description: In springquery, @Querys*([^)]*+ mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via :named parameters.
applicability: springquery data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
